info.name: Admin Dashboard APIs
info.description:
Covers all Admin Dashboard APIs from docs/Franchise/API_Requirements_Admin_Dashboard.md:

- Part A: Dashboard Components (A.1–A.7)
- Part B: Approval Queue APIs (B.1–B.7)
- Part C: Commission Run APIs (C.1–C.4)
- Part D: Report APIs (D.1–D.7)

All routes use the /api prefix (Program.cs RoutePrefixConvention). Admin-only endpoints require [AdminOnly] attribute — a franchisee token will be rejected.

Run order: log in first (Auth folder) -> then any admin endpoint, using the adminToken from login.

RESPONSE ENVELOPE (verified against ResponseFilterAttribute + ResponseModel): the real payload is ALWAYS nested under `.data`.

GET/DELETE: { data, errorCode (0=ok, 1=error), errorDescription, message: {message, messageType}|null, isFeedbackSet }
POST/PUT adds: modelValidation: { isValid, errors }

Authorization = Bearer adminToken.

request.description: Response.data.accessToken -> adminToken. The token carries UserId/RoleId claims. The [AdminOnly] attribute checks the role claim — a franchisee token is rejected with 403.

item.name: A - Dashboard
item.description: Part A — Dashboard Components (A.1–A.7). All endpoints return live data for the admin dashboard.

request.description:
Returns three live counts that need admin attention.

.data shape (ActionRequiredCountsResponse):
{
  "pendingBusinessEntries": 5,
  "pendingFranchiseeApprovals": 2,
  "pendingWithdrawalRequests": 1
}

These are LIVE counts — not month-scoped. A pending item from last month still needs action today. Returns zeros (not empty) when everything is cleared.

Returns four headline numbers for the selected month.

.data shape (MonthlySummaryResponse):
{
  "totalApprovedBusiness": 5000000,
  "previousMonthBusiness": 4200000,
  "businessPercentageChange": 19.0,
  "totalCommissionPayout": 150000,
  "payoutRatio": 3.0,
  "isPayoutProvisional": false,
  "totalFranchisees": 120,
  "newFranchiseesThisMonth": 8,
  "activeFranchiseesThisMonth": 95,
  "activePercentage": 79.2,
  "isCurrentMonth": true
}

Edge cases:
- Current incomplete month: isCurrentMonth=true, figures are month-to-date.
- First month ever: businessPercentageChange=null (UI hides comparison).
- Commission run not executed: isPayoutProvisional=true.

item.name: A.3 Get Business vs Payout Trend

request.description:
Returns count of franchisees at each performance level.

.data shape (LevelDistributionResponse):
{
  "totalFranchisees": 120,
  "belowLevel1": 15,
  "level1": 40,
  "level2": 30,
  "level3": 20,
  "level4": 10,
  "level5": 5,
  "isProvisional": false
}

Edge cases:
- Franchisees below Level 1 threshold: counted in belowLevel1 (reconciles against total).
- Current incomplete month: isProvisional=true (levels change as entries are approved).

Returns highest-contributing franchisees sorted by team business.

.data shape (TopPerformersResponse):
{
  "performers": [
    {
      "rank": 1,
      "regNo": 1001,
      "name": "Rajesh Kumar",
      "level": 3,
      "location": "Delhi",
      "directReferralCount": 12,
      "teamBusiness": 2500000
    },
    ...
  ]
}

Edge cases:
- Ties: secondary sort by referral count, then join date.
- Fewer than 3 active franchisees: returns whatever is available.

Returns readiness state for the monthly commission run.

.data shape (MonthEndStatusResponse):
{
  "totalSubmittedEntries": 150,
  "approvedEntries": 140,
  "pendingEntries": 10,
  "commissionRunStatus": "Approved",
  "commissionRunDate": "2026-09-01T02:15:00",
  "isOverdue": false,
  "hasPostRunDiscrepancy": false,
  "daysRemainingInMonth": 26
}

Edge cases:
- Commission run completed but new entries approved after: hasPostRunDiscrepancy=true.
- Month ended but no run executed: isOverdue=true, commissionRunStatus="NotRun".

Returns most recent system events in reverse chronological order.

.data shape (RecentActivityResponse):
{
  "activities": [
    {
      "eventType": "BusinessEntryApproved",
      "description": "Business entry #42 approved — Rs.250,000.00 for 15 Aug 2026",
      "relatedEntityId": 42,
      "entityType": "BusinessEntry",
      "occurredOn": "2026-08-15T14:30:00",
      "performedBy": "Admin User"
    },
    ...
  ]
}

Edge cases:
- No activity yet: returns empty activities array.
- Bulk actions: grouped as single event.

item.name: B - Approval Queue
item.description: Part B — Approval Queue APIs (B.1–B.7). Admin reviews and approves/rejects pending items.

query.description: Optional: filter by franchisee name or LoginID

request.description:
Returns all business entries awaiting admin approval.

.data shape: ARRAY of PendingBusinessEntryItem:
[
  {
    "id": 42,
    "regNo": 1001,
    "franchiseeName": "Rajesh Kumar",
    "entryDate": "2026-08-31",
    "amount": 250000,
    "submittedOn": "2026-08-31T23:45:00"
  },
  ...
]

Sortable and filterable by franchisee name/LoginID or date range.

Rejects a business entry with a reason. The reason is recorded and shown to the franchisee.

Response.data: { "message": "Business entry rejected successfully." }

Approves multiple pending entries at once. Returns per-entry results — some may succeed and others fail.

.data shape (BulkApproveEntriesResponse):
{
  "totalRequested": 4,
  "approvedCount": 3,
  "failedCount": 1,
  "results": [
    { "entryId": 42, "success": true, "errorMessage": null },
    { "entryId": 43, "success": true, "errorMessage": null },
    { "entryId": 44, "success": true, "errorMessage": null },
    { "entryId": 45, "success": false, "errorMessage": "Cannot approve entry for July 2026 — commission run already completed." }
  ]
}

Edge cases:
- Some entries fail validation: API reports per-entry results, does NOT fail the whole batch.

Returns all franchisee registrations awaiting admin activation.

.data shape: ARRAY of PendingFranchiseeItem:
[
  {
    "id": 15,
    "name": "Amit Singh",
    "contactNumber": "9876543210",
    "location": "Mumbai",
    "referrerRegNo": 1001,
    "referrerName": "Rajesh Kumar",
    "paymentConfirmed": true,
    "submittedOn": "2026-08-20T10:00:00"
  },
  ...
]

Activates a pending franchisee. On approval:
- Franchisee becomes Active (ConfPayNo = 1)
- If referrer exists AND is active AND hasn't received referral income yet: Rs.1,000 Direct Referral Income is credited to referrer's wallet.
- If referrer is inactive or already paid: income is NOT credited (audit log records why).

Edge cases:
- Referrer deactivated since referral: approval proceeds but no income credited.
- Duplicate phone/email detected: blocked with clear reason.

Response.data: { "message": "Franchisee approved successfully." }

Rejects a franchisee registration with a reason. No income is generated.

Response.data: { "message": "Franchisee rejected successfully." }

Returns all withdrawal requests awaiting admin action.

.data shape: ARRAY of PendingWithdrawalItem:
[
  {
    "id": 8,
    "regNo": 1001,
    "franchiseeName": "Rajesh Kumar",
    "requestedAmount": 50000,
    "walletBalance": 120000,
    "requestedOn": "2026-08-25T16:30:00"
  },
  ...
]

Approves a withdrawal request and debits the wallet.

IMPORTANT: The API checks current wallet balance at approval time — if balance dropped below the requested amount since the request was submitted, approval is BLOCKED with errorCode=1.

The API is IDEMPOTENT: approving the same request twice is blocked (status check).

Response.data: { "message": "Withdrawal approved and wallet debited." }

Rejects a withdrawal request. Wallet is untouched.

Response.data: { "message": "Withdrawal rejected." }

item.name: C - Commission Run
item.description: Part C — Commission Run APIs (C.1–C.4). Preview, execute, and review monthly commission calculations.

request.description:
Shows what would happen before executing the run. Nothing is written to wallets.

.data shape (CommissionRunPreviewResponse):
{
  "totalBusiness": 5000000,
  "calculatedTotalPayout": 150000,
  "franchiseeCount": 95,
  "pendingEntriesCount": 10,
  "warnings": [
    "10 business entries are still pending approval. Running now will exclude them from the calculation."
  ],
  "alreadyRun": false,
  "existingRunId": null
}

Edge cases:
- Pending entries still exist: warning prominently displayed.
- Run already completed for this month: alreadyRun=true, existingRunId set.

Calculates and stores commission for all active franchisees. Credits NOTHING — admin must approve the run separately.

.data shape (ExecuteCommissionRunResponse):
{
  "runId": 12,
  "totalBusiness": 5000000,
  "totalCommission": 150000,
  "franchiseeCount": 95,
  "status": "PendingApproval"
}

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Idempotent: second run for same month requires confirmRerun=true.
- Franchisee with higher-level referral: that referral contributes zero (negative-diff floor).
- Franchisee with no business and no referrals: included with zero commission.
- Failure partway: rolls back completely.

After execution, use C.3 History to view or POST approve on the run.

Returns the log of past commission runs.

.data shape: ARRAY of CommissionRunHistoryItem:
[
  {
    "id": 12,
    "year": 2026,
    "month": 8,
    "status": "Approved",
    "totalBusiness": 4200000,
    "totalCommission": 126000,
    "franchiseeCount": 88,
    "calculatedOn": "2026-09-01T02:00:00",
    "approvedOn": "2026-09-01T10:30:00",
    "approvedBy": "Admin User"
  },
  ...
]

Returns the detailed calculation behind one franchisee's commission.

.data shape (CommissionBreakdownResponse):
{
  "regNo": 1001,
  "franchiseeName": "Rajesh Kumar",
  "year": 2026,
  "month": 8,
  "level": 3,
  "levelPercentage": 3.0,
  "selfBusiness": 500000,
  "teamBusiness": 1500000,
  "ownBusinessCommission": 15000,
  "differentialCommission": 30000,
  "totalCommission": 45000,
  "referralContributions": [
    {
      "referralRegNo": 1005,
      "referralName": "Amit Singh",
      "referralSelfBusiness": 200000,
      "referralLevelPercentage": 2.0,
      "sponsorLevelPercentage": 3.0,
      "differentialAmount": 2000,
      "zeroReason": null
    },
    {
      "referralRegNo": 1008,
      "referralName": "Priya Sharma",
      "referralSelfBusiness": 300000,
      "referralLevelPercentage": 3.0,
      "sponsorLevelPercentage": 3.0,
      "differentialAmount": 0,
      "zeroReason": "Referral level percentage meets or exceeds sponsor level — negative difference floored at zero"
    }
  ]
}

Edge cases:
- Referral contributed zero due to negative-diff rule: still listed with zeroReason, not omitted.
- This is the ONLY endpoint accessible to franchisees (for their own data only).

item.name: D - Reports
item.description: Part D — Report APIs (D.1–D.7). Every report accepts a date range, supports pagination. Reports include only approved entries. Export to Excel/PDF is a UI concern — these endpoints return the data.

request.description:
Franchisee-wise approved business for a selected date range.

.data shape (PagedReportResponse<BusinessReportItem>):
{
  "items": [
    {
      "regNo": 1001,
      "franchiseeName": "Rajesh Kumar",
      "location": "Delhi",
      "level": 3,
      "totalBusiness": 2500000,
      "entryCount": 30
    },
    ...
  ],
  "totalRecords": 120,
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 50,
  "totalPages": 3
}

Sortable by amount. Filterable by location and level.
